segments.mn120:1.1: Evaṃ me sutaṃ – ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā sāvatthiyaṃ viharati jetavane anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
segments.mn120:2.1: “saṅkhārupapattiṃ [saṅkhārūpapattiṃ (syā. kaṃ.), saṅkhāruppattiṃ (sī. pī.)] vo, bhikkhave, desessāmi, taṃ suṇātha, sādhukaṃ manasi karotha;
segments.mn120:2.3: “Evaṃ, bhante”ti kho te bhikkhū bhagavato paccassosuṃ.
segments.mn120:3.1: “Idha, bhikkhave, bhikkhu saddhāya samannāgato hoti, sīlena samannāgato hoti, sutena samannāgato hoti, cāgena samannāgato hoti, paññāya samannāgato hoti.
segments.mn120:3.3: ‘aho vatāhaṃ kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā khattiyamahāsālānaṃ [khattiyamahāsālānaṃ vā (syā. kaṃ. pī.)] sahabyataṃ upapajjeyyan’ti.
segments.mn120:3.4: So taṃ cittaṃ dahati, taṃ cittaṃ adhiṭṭhāti, taṃ cittaṃ bhāveti.
segments.mn120:3.5: Tassa te saṅkhārā ca vihārā [vihāro (sī. pī.)] ca evaṃ bhāvitā evaṃ bahulīkatā tatrupapattiyā [tatrūpapattiyā (syā. kaṃ.), tatruppattiyā (sī. pī.)] saṃvattanti.
segments.mn120:3.6: Ayaṃ, bhikkhave, maggo ayaṃ paṭipadā tatrupapattiyā saṃvattati.
segments.mn120:4-5.1: “Puna caparaṃ, bhikkhave, bhikkhu saddhāya samannāgato hoti, sīlena samannāgato hoti, sutena samannāgato hoti, cāgena samannāgato hoti, paññāya samannāgato hoti.
segments.mn120:4-5.3: ‘aho vatāhaṃ kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā brāhmaṇamahāsālānaṃ … pe … gahapatimahāsālānaṃ [brāhmaṇamahāsālānaṃ vā gahapatimahāsālānaṃ vā (syā. kaṃ. pī.)] sahabyataṃ upapajjeyyan’ti.
segments.mn120:4-5.5: So taṃ cittaṃ dahati, taṃ cittaṃ adhiṭṭhāti, taṃ cittaṃ bhāveti.
segments.mn120:4-5.6: Tassa te saṅkhārā ca vihārā ca evaṃ bhāvitā evaṃ bahulīkatā tatrupapattiyā saṃvattanti.
segments.mn120:4-5.7: Ayaṃ, bhikkhave, maggo ayaṃ paṭipadā tatrupapattiyā saṃvattati.
segments.mn120:6.1: “Puna caparaṃ, bhikkhave, bhikkhu saddhāya samannāgato hoti, sīlena samannāgato hoti, sutena samannāgato hoti, cāgena samannāgato hoti, paññāya samannāgato hoti.
segments.mn120:6.3: ‘cātumahārājikā [cātummahārājikā (sī. syā. kaṃ. pī.)] devā dīghāyukā vaṇṇavanto sukhabahulā’ti.
segments.mn120:6.5: ‘aho vatāhaṃ kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā cātumahārājikānaṃ devānaṃ sahabyataṃ upapajjeyyan’ti.
segments.mn120:6.6: So taṃ cittaṃ dahati, taṃ cittaṃ adhiṭṭhāti, taṃ cittaṃ bhāveti.
segments.mn120:6.7: Tassa te saṅkhārā ca vihārā ca evaṃ bhāvitā evaṃ bahulīkatā tatrupapattiyā saṃvattanti.
segments.mn120:6.8: Ayaṃ, bhikkhave, maggo ayaṃ paṭipadā tatrupapattiyā saṃvattati.
segments.mn120:7-11.1: “Puna caparaṃ, bhikkhave, bhikkhu saddhāya samannāgato hoti, sīlena samannāgato hoti, sutena samannāgato hoti, cāgena samannāgato hoti, paññāya samannāgato hoti.
segments.mn120:7-11.2: Tassa sutaṃ hoti – tāvatiṃsā devā … pe … yāmā devā … tusitā devā … nimmānaratī devā … paranimmitavasavattī devā dīghāyukā vaṇṇavanto sukhabahulāti.
segments.mn120:7-11.9: ‘aho vatāhaṃ kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā paranimmitavasavattīnaṃ devānaṃ sahabyataṃ upapajjeyyan’ti.
segments.mn120:7-11.10: So taṃ cittaṃ dahati, taṃ cittaṃ adhiṭṭhāti, taṃ cittaṃ bhāveti.
segments.mn120:7-11.11: Tassa te saṅkhārā ca vihārā ca evaṃ bhāvitā evaṃ bahulīkatā tatrupapattiyā saṃvattanti.
segments.mn120:7-11.12: Ayaṃ, bhikkhave, maggo ayaṃ paṭipadā tatrupapattiyā saṃvattati.
segments.mn120:12.1: “Puna caparaṃ, bhikkhave, bhikkhu saddhāya samannāgato hoti, sīlena samannāgato hoti, sutena samannāgato hoti, cāgena samannāgato hoti, paññāya samannāgato hoti.
segments.mn120:12.4: Sahasso, bhikkhave, brahmā sahassilokadhātuṃ [sahassiṃ lokadhātuṃ (sī.)] pharitvā adhimuccitvā [adhimuñcitvā (ka.)] viharati.
segments.mn120:12.5: Yepi tattha sattā upapannā tepi pharitvā adhimuccitvā viharati.
segments.mn120:12.6: Seyyathāpi, bhikkhave, cakkhumā puriso ekaṃ āmaṇḍaṃ hatthe karitvā paccavekkheyya;
segments.mn120:12.7: evameva kho, bhikkhave, sahasso brahmā sahassilokadhātuṃ pharitvā adhimuccitvā viharati.
segments.mn120:12.8: Yepi tattha sattā upapannā tepi pharitvā adhimuccitvā viharati.
segments.mn120:12.10: ‘aho vatāhaṃ kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā sahassassa brahmuno sahabyataṃ upapajjeyyan’ti.
segments.mn120:12.11: So taṃ cittaṃ dahati, taṃ cittaṃ adhiṭṭhāti, taṃ cittaṃ bhāveti.
segments.mn120:12.12: Tassa te saṅkhārā ca vihārā ca evaṃ bhāvitā evaṃ bahulīkatā tatrupapattiyā saṃvattanti.
segments.mn120:12.13: Ayaṃ, bhikkhave, maggo ayaṃ paṭipadā tatrupapattiyā saṃvattati.
segments.mn120:13-16.1: “Puna caparaṃ, bhikkhave, bhikkhu saddhāya samannāgato hoti, sīlena samannāgato hoti, sutena … cāgena … paññāya samannāgato hoti.
segments.mn120:13-16.4: Tassa sutaṃ hoti – dvisahasso brahmā … pe … tisahasso brahmā … catusahasso brahmā … pañcasahasso brahmā dīghāyuko vaṇṇavā sukhabahuloti.
segments.mn120:13-16.9: Pañcasahasso, bhikkhave, brahmā pañcasahassilokadhātuṃ pharitvā adhimuccitvā viharati.

segments.mn120:13-16.12: evameva kho, bhikkhave, pañcasahasso brahmā pañcasahassilokadhātuṃ pharitvā adhimuccitvā viharati.

segments.mn120:13-16.16: So taṃ cittaṃ dahati, taṃ cittaṃ adhiṭṭhāti, taṃ cittaṃ bhāveti.
segments.mn120:13-16.17: Tassa te saṅkhārā ca vihārā ca evaṃ bhāvitā evaṃ bahulīkatā tatrupapattiyā saṃvattanti.
segments.mn120:13-16.18: Ayaṃ, bhikkhave, maggo ayaṃ paṭipadā tatrupapattiyā saṃvattati.

segments.mn120:17.6: Dasasahasso, bhikkhave, brahmā dasasahassilokadhātuṃ pharitvā adhimuccitvā viharati.

segments.mn120:19.1: “Puna caparaṃ, bhikkhave, bhikkhu saddhāya samannāgato hoti, sīlena … sutena … cāgena … paññāya samannāgato hoti.
segments.mn120:19.5: Tassa sutaṃ hoti – ābhā devā … pe … parittābhā devā … appamāṇābhā devā … ābhassarā devā dīghāyukā vaṇṇavanto sukhabahulāti.

segments.mn120:20.5: Tassa sutaṃ hoti – parittasubhā devā … pe … appamāṇasubhā devā … subhakiṇhā devā dīghāyukā vaṇṇavanto sukhabahulāti.

segments.mn120:21-30.5: Tassa sutaṃ hoti – vehapphalā devā … pe … avihā devā … atappā devā … sudassā devā … sudassī devā … akaniṭṭhā devā dīghāyukā vaṇṇavanto sukhabahulāti.
segments.mn120:21-30.13: ‘aho vatāhaṃ kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā akaniṭṭhānaṃ devānaṃ sahabyataṃ upapajjeyyan’ti.

segments.mn120:31.8: ‘aho vatāhaṃ kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā ākāsānañcāyatanūpagānaṃ devānaṃ sahabyataṃ upapajjeyyan’ti.

segments.mn120:32.1: “Puna caparaṃ, bhikkhave, bhikkhu saddhāya samannāgato hoti, sīlena … sutena … cāgena … paññāya samannāgato hoti.
segments.mn120:32.8: ‘aho vatāhaṃ kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā viññāṇañcāyatanūpagānaṃ devānaṃ sahabyataṃ upapajjeyyan’ti.

segments.mn120:33-36.5: Tassa sutaṃ hoti – ākiñcaññāyatanūpagā devā … pe … nevasaññānāsaññāyatanūpagā devā dīghāyukā ciraṭṭhitikā sukhabahulāti.
segments.mn120:33-36.9: ‘aho vatāhaṃ kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā nevasaññānāsaññāyatanūpagānaṃ devānaṃ sahabyataṃ upapajjeyyan’ti.

segments.mn120:37.1: “Puna caparaṃ, bhikkhave, bhikkhu saddhāya samannāgato hoti, sīlena … sutena … cāgena … paññāya samannāgato hoti.
segments.mn120:37.6: ‘aho vatāhaṃ āsavānaṃ khayā anāsavaṃ cetovimuttiṃ paññāvimuttiṃ diṭṭheva dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja vihareyyan’ti.
segments.mn120:37.7: So āsavānaṃ khayā anāsavaṃ cetovimuttiṃ paññāvimuttiṃ diṭṭheva dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharati.
segments.mn120:37.8: Ayaṃ, bhikkhave, bhikkhu na katthaci upapajjatī”ti [na katthaci upapajjati, na kuhiñci upapajjatīti (sī. pī.), na katthaci upapajjati, na kuhiñci upasampajja viharatīti.(ka.)].
segments.mn120:37.10: Attamanā te bhikkhū bhagavato bhāsitaṃ abhinandunti.
segments.mn120:38.3: Buddhassa kittināma-cattārīsena, ānāpāno kāyagato upapatti [ito paraṃ syā. kaṃ. ka. potthakesu evampi dissati –-§ candake vimale parisuddhe, puṇṇasammodinirodhaattano;§ dandhā bahujanasevitaṃ dhammavaraṃ, yaṃ anupadaṃ vaggavaraṃ dutiyāti].

lines: Tattha saṅkhārupapattinti saṅkhārānaṃyeva upapattiṃ, na sattassa, na posassa, puññābhisaṅkhārena vā bhavūpagakkhandhānaṃ upapattiṃ.
Saddhāya samannāgatoti saddhādayo pañca dhammā lokikā vaṭṭanti.
Saṅkhārā ca vihārā cāti saha patthanāya saddhādayova pañca dhammā.
Ayaṃ maggo ayaṃ paṭipadāti saha patthanāya pañca dhammāva.
Yassa hi pañca dhammā atthi, na patthanā, tassa gati anibaddhā.
Yassa patthanā atthi, na pañca dhammā, tassapi anibaddhā.
Yesaṃ ubhayaṃ atthi, tesaṃ gati nibaddhā.
Yathā hi ākāse khittadaṇḍo aggena vā majjhena vā mūlena vā nipatissatīti niyamo natthi, evaṃ sattānaṃ paṭisandhiggahaṇaṃ aniyataṃ.
Tasmā kusalaṃ kammaṃ katvā ekasmiṃ ṭhāne patthanaṃ kātuṃ vaṭṭati.
Yathā taṃ parisuddhacakkhussa purisassa sabbasova pākaṭaṃ hoti, evaṃ tassa brahmuno saddhiṃ tattha nibbattasattehi sahassī lokadhātu.

Nikkhanti nikkhena kataṃ piḷandhanaṃ, nikkhaṃ nāma pañcasuvaṇṇaṃ, ūnakanikkhena kataṃ pasādhanañhi ghaṭṭanamajjanakkhamaṃ na hoti, atirekena kataṃ ghaṭṭanamajjanaṃ khamati, vaṇṇavantaṃ pana na hoti, pharusadhātukaṃ khāyati.
Nikkhena kataṃ ghaṭṭanamajjanañceva khamati, vaṇṇavantañca hoti.

Mahājamburukkhassa hi ekekā sākhā paṇṇāsa paṇṇāsa yojanāni vaḍḍhitā, tāsu mahantā nadiyo sandanti, tāsaṃ nadīnaṃ ubhayatīresu jambupakkānaṃ patitaṭṭhāne suvaṇṇaṅkurā uṭṭhahanti, te nadījalena vuyhamānā anupubbena mahāsamuddaṃ pavisanti.
Dakkhakammāraputtaukkāmukhasukusalasampahaṭṭhanti dakkhena sukusalena kammāraputtena ukkāmukhe pacitvā sampahaṭṭhaṃ.
Vatthopame (ma. ni.1.75-76) ca dhātuvibhaṅge (ma. ni.3.357-360) ca piṇḍasodhanaṃ vuttaṃ.
Yaṃ pana sabbavāresu pharitvā adhimuccitvāti vuttaṃ, tattha pañcavidhaṃ pharaṇaṃ cetopharaṇaṃ kasiṇapharaṇaṃ dibbacakkhupharaṇaṃ ālokapharaṇaṃ sarīrapharaṇanti.
Tattha cetopharaṇaṃ nāma lokadhātusahasse sattānaṃ cittajānanaṃ.
Dibbacakkhupharaṇaṃ nāma ālokaṃ vaḍḍhetvā dibbena cakkhunā sahassalokadhātudassanaṃ.
Sabbattha imāni pañca pharaṇāni avināsentena kathetabbanti.
“maṇiopamme kasiṇapharaṇaṃ viya nikkhopamme sarīrapharaṇaṃ viya dissatī”ti.
Tassa vādaṃ viya aṭṭhakathā nāma natthīti paṭikkhitvā sarīrapharaṇaṃ na sabbakālikaṃ, cattārimāni pharaṇāni avināsetvāva kathetabbanti vuttaṃ.
Adhimuccatīti padaṃ pharaṇapadasseva vevacanaṃ, atha vā pharatīti pattharati.
Ābhātiādīsu ābhādayo nāma pāṭiyekkā devā natthi, tayo parittābhādayo devā ābhā nāma, parittāsubhādayo ca.
Yasmā avadhāraṇaṃ etasmiṃ pade icchitabbanti,“saṅkhārānaṃyeva upapattin”ti vatvā tena nivattitaṃ dassento,“na sattassā”ti āha.
Tena satto jīvo uppajjatīti micchāvādaṃ paṭikkhipati.
Evaṃ uppajjanakadhammavasena uppattiṃ dassetvā idāni uppattijanakadhammavasenapi taṃ dassetuṃ,“puññābhisaṅkhārena vā”tiādi vuttaṃ.
Tattha kāmesu puññābhisaṅkhārenapi upapatti hoti, sā pana imasmiṃ sutte gahitāti.
Puññābhisaṅkhārena vāti vā -saddo avuttatthāpekkhaṇavikappattho, avuttatthāpekkhāya pana na āgato “āneñjābhisaṅkhārenā”ti.
Atha vā upapatti āgatā, evaṃ kiccaṃ āgataṃ, āneñjābhisaṅkhāro panettha sarūpena anāgatopi puññābhisaṅkhāraggahaṇeneva gahitoti daṭṭhabbaṃ.
Bhavūpapattihetubhūtā okappanīyasaddhā catupārisuddhisīlaṃ tādisaṃ buddhavacanabāhusaccaṃ āmisapariccāgo kammassakatāñāṇaṃ kammaphaladiṭṭhi ca ime saddhādayo veditabbā.
Sahapatthanāyāti,“aho vatāhaṃ … pe … upapajjeyyan”ti evaṃ pavattapatthanāya saha.
Saddhādayovāti yathāvuttā saddhādayo eva pañca dhammā upapattiyā saṅkharaṇaṭṭhena saṅkhārā, tasmā eva aññehi visiṭṭhabhavūpaharaṇaṭṭhena vihārā nāmāti.
Cetanā panettha suddhasaṅkhāratāya saddhādiggahaṇeneva gahitā, tasmā avadhāraṇaṃ kataṃ.
Upapattipakappanavaseneva pavattiyā patthanāgahaṇeneva tassā gahaṇanti keci.

Cetanā hi nāma kammaṃ, tassā upapattinibbattane vattabbameva natthi, tassā pana kiccakaraṇā saddhādayo patthanā cāti ime dhammā sahakārino bhavūpapattiyā niyāmakā hontīti tatrūpapattiyā pavattantīti tesaṃ maggādibhāvo vutto.
Tena saddhā patthanā cāti ubhaye dhammā sahitā hutvā kammaṃ visesentā gatiṃ niyamentīti dasseti, paṭisandhiggahaṇaṃ aniyataṃ kevalassa kammassa vasenāti adhippāyo.
Kāmañcettha “kammaṃ katvā”ti vuttaṃ, kammāyūhanato pana pageva patthanaṃ ṭhapetumpi vaṭṭatiyeva.
Kammaṃ katvāti cettha “tāpetvā bhuñjati, bhutvā sayatī”tiādīsu viya na kālaniyamo, kammaṃ katvā yadā kadāci patthanaṃ kātuṃ vaṭṭatīti ca idaṃ cārittadassanaṃ viya vuttaṃ.
Yathā hi bhavapatthanā yāva maggena na samucchijjati, tāva anuppannābhinavakatūpacitassa kammassa paccayo hotiyeva.
Puna tathā visesapaccayo, yathā niyametvā uppāditā.
“yassa pañca dhammā atthi, na patthanā tassa gati anibaddhā”ti.
Sabbasovāti “idaṃ kāḷakaṃ sāmaṃ setaṃ haritaṃ maṇḍalaṃ aparimaṇḍalaṃ caturaṃsaṃ paripuṇṇaṃ khuddakaṃ mahantan”tiādinā sabbasova pākaṭaṃ hoti.
Tassa pana tattha obhāsakaraṇaṃ pākaṭanti āha “ālokapharaṇabrahmā”ti.
Vaṇṇavantaṃ pana na hoti avipulatāya uḷāraṃ hutvā anupaṭṭhānato.
Tāsūti tāsu bhūmīsu, yattha sākhā vaḍḍhitvā ṭhitā.
“dhotaghaṭṭitapamajjitan”ti, tambamattikalepaṃ katvā dhotañceva pāsāṇādinā ghaṭṭitañca eḷakalomādinā pamajjitañcāti attho.
tattakaṃ ṭhānaṃ dibbacakkhuñāṇaṃ phusatīti dibbacakkhupharaṇe dassite ālokapharaṇaṃ dassitamevāti attho.
Kasiṇapharaṇaṃ viyāti kasiṇobhāsena pharaṇaṃ viya dissati upaṭṭhāti, maṇipabhāpharaṇassa viya brahmaloke dhātupharaṇassa dassitattāti adhippāyo.
Sarīrapabhā pana nikkhapabhāsadisāti,“nikkhopamme sarīrapharaṇaṃ viya dissatī”ti vuttaṃ.
Aṭṭhakathā nāma natthīti pāḷipadassa atthavaṇṇanāya nāma nicchitāya bhavitabbaṃ, avinicchitāya pana natthi viyāti akathanaṃ nāma aṭṭhakathāya anāciṇṇanti tassa vādaṃ paṭikkhipitvā.
Yathā hi vattabbaṃ, tathā avatvā “viyā”ti vacanaṃ kimatthiyanti adhippāyo.
Buddhānaṃ byāmappabhā byāmappadese sabbakālaṃ adhiṭṭhāti viya tassa brahmuno sarīrapharaṇaṃ sarīrābhāya pattharaṇaṃ sabbakālikaṃ.
Ābhāti dutiyajjhānabhūmike deve ekajjhaṃ gahetvā sādhāraṇato vuttaṃ.
Sādhāraṇato katāyapi patthanāya jhānaṅgaṃ parittaṃ bhāvitañce, parittābhesu upapatti hoti, majjhimañce, appamāṇābhesu, paṇītañce, ābhassaresu upapatti hotīti daṭṭhabbaṃ.
